plugins/glowscreen32/core/class/glowscre.Ce binaire ne porte pas de marqueur de v: This binary carries no GlowScreen32 version marker ("%s<version>", null terminated): it was not produced by this project, or the version was not bumped. This is the address the firmware calls. It is not set here: it follows from the internal access configured under Settings → System → Configuration → Networks.
plugins/glowscreen32/plugin_info/configu.Aucun écran déclaré. Une carte flashée m: No screen declared yet. A flashed but undeclared board shows its own MAC address: copy it into a new plugin device to enrol it.
plugins/glowscreen32/plugin_info/configu.C'est la façon normale de présenter la c: This is the normal way to present the key. The ?apikey= URL-parameter fallback is still accepted, to try the endpoint from a browser, but it writes the key in the clear in Apache's logs at every call — and a board calls every thirty seconds.
plugins/glowscreen32/plugin_info/configu.Il se règle sur la page du plugin, dans: It is set on the plugin page, in the "Firmware" box, next to the binary upload and the fleet table — that is where a rollout is driven from, and an emergency stop must be within reach of whoever is watching the screens come back online. It is closed by default.
plugins/glowscreen32/plugin_info/configu.La clé API du plugin, la même pour tout: The plugin API key, the same for the whole fleet — the firmware is identical on every board, each one recognising itself by its MAC address alone. It is changed in Settings → System → Configuration → API tab, GlowScreen32 row; it must then be copied into each board's firmware, which has no way to ask for it again.
plugins/glowscreen32/plugin_info/configu.Le dernier contact est horodaté à chaque: Last contact is stamped at every call received from the board, "layout" as well as "ping", and rounded to the minute: a board queries every thirty seconds, and stamping each call would mean one database write for a piece of information whose seconds nobody reads. "Offline" shows beyond three refresh intervals without news. A screen without a MAC address is reachable by no board at all.
plugins/glowscreen32/plugin_info/configu.Un écran ne reçoit une mise à jour que s: A screen only receives an update if the global lock AND its own lock are open. Both are closed by default, and a blocked board receives exactly the answer of an up-to-date one: it has no way to go around it.
plugins/glowscreen32/plugin_info/configu.Une carte qui présente la clé ne peut dé: A board presenting the key can only trigger the buttons configured on the screen carrying its MAC address. It can neither read the installation nor command anything else: an identifier absent from that screen's layout is refused. This endpoint is not meant to be exposed on the Internet.

Shown at the top of the screen.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Aucun écran pour le moment. Pour démarre: No screen yet. To get started:
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Ce compteur augmente à chaque changement: This counter goes up at every layout change. The board watches it and only redraws its screen when it moves.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Cliquez sur « Ajouter un écran » et donn: Click "Add a screen" and give it a name, for instance "Living room".
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Deux verrous, tous deux fermés par défau: Two locks, both closed by default.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Enregistrez, puis reportez l'URL et la c: Save, then copy the URL and the key from the "What the board needs" box into the firmware.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Fermé par défaut. Cet écran ne recevra d: Closed by default. This screen will only receive an update if this lock AND the plugin global lock are open — that is what makes it possible to open a single pilot screen, check that it comes back online, then open the others. While it is closed the board receives exactly the answer it would get if it were up to date.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Jusqu'à quatre pages, douze boutons par: Up to four pages, twelve buttons per page, thirty-two in all.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.L'OTA est la seule fonction où Jeedom pe: OTA is the only function where Jeedom can durably break a screen remotely: the board would have to come off the wall and back onto USB. So both the global lock below AND the lock of the screen concerned (the device's "Screen" tab) must be open for a board to receive an update. A blocked board gets exactly the same answer as an up-to-date one: it has no way to tell the difference, hence no way to go around it.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.L'adresse MAC de l'ESP32, avec ou sans s: The MAC address of the ESP32, with or without separators: it, and it alone, binds this device to a board. It is printed on the board's serial console at boot.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.La carte télécharge cette URL et vérifie: The board downloads this URL and checks the SHA-256 digest BEFORE switching to the new partition. The digest is computed here, on the file actually written, and never taken from an input field.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.La clé se présente dans cet en-tête. En: The key is presented in this header. As a URL parameter it works too, but Apache then writes it in the clear in its logs at every call.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.La même pour tout le parc : le firmware: The same for the whole fleet: the firmware is identical on every board. Settings → System → Configuration → API tab, GlowScreen32 row.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.La page en cours d'édition, sur un écran: The page being edited, on a 320×240 screen, as the board will draw it: the grid follows the "Screen" tab setting. The preview follows what you type; it says nothing about lamp states, which only the board knows. The identifier under each tile is the GLOBAL id of contract v2, the one the board sends back to "press" — it runs continuously over the whole screen, pages included.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.La version que la carte a annoncée lors: The version the board reported at its last call. It comes from the board, not from Jeedom: until it has queried a plugin able to read it, it stays unknown.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Le balayage change de page d'un glisseme: Swiping changes page with a finger slide; off by default, because an accidental swipe happens quickly on a resistive touch panel. The clock shows in the banner, from the server time: the board uses no NTP.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Le binaire est rangé dans <code><?php ec: The binary is stored in this directory is not writable by the web server'; ?>. It is excluded from plugin deployment: a redeploy does not erase it.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Le dernier appel reçu de cette carte, «: The last call received from this board, "layout" as well as "ping", rounded to the minute. With several screens this is the field that tells which one stopped answering. The value shown dates from when the page was opened.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Le dernier contact est horodaté à chaque: Last contact is stamped at every call received, "layout" as well as "ping". It is rounded to the minute: a board queries every thirty seconds, and stamping each call would mean one database write for a piece of information whose seconds nobody reads. "Offline" shows beyond three refresh intervals without news. The "Firmware" column is the version the board itself reports; "OTA lock" is the result of BOTH locks, the plugin's and the screen's — those two columns are what a staged rollout is driven with.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Le fichier <code>.bin</code> produit par: The .bin file produced by PlatformIO (.pio/build/cyd/firmware.bin). The version is read INSIDE the binary, from the marker the firmware engraves there: it is the same one the board reports, which is the only way to compare the two. A file that does not start with byte 0xE9 is refused — it is not an ESP32 application image.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Le nombre de cases par page, sur l'écran: The number of slots per page, on the 320×240 screen. 3×3 by default. A board whose firmware predates v2 can only draw 3×2, and will in any case receive only the first six buttons. Shrinking the grid loses no button: those whose slot no longer exists are moved to the first free slot, and the log says so.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Prend effet immédiatement, sans enregist: Takes effect immediately, without saving: this is an emergency stop, it must not depend on a "Save" button. Every change is written to the plugin log.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Remplissez les boutons : un libellé, une: Fill in the buttons: a label, a colour, an icon, and what a press triggers.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Saisissez l'adresse MAC de la carte ESP3: Type the MAC address of the ESP32 board, as it appears on its console at boot.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Secondes entre deux vérifications de la: Seconds between two checks by the board. It is advice given to the board, not a constraint: it stays free to set its own pace. Each check is a PHP request on the box, 30 seconds is a good compromise.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Un écran désactivé n'est plus reconnu pa: A disabled screen is no longer recognised by the API: the board receives "unknown_device" and commands nothing any more.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Une carte dont le firmware est antérieur: A board whose firmware predates v2
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Une température, une humidité, une puiss: A temperature, a humidity, a power figure: the value is formatted HERE — rounded, with its unit, sixteen characters at most — and the board only displays it. It travels in the "ping", so it does not make the screen redraw at every degree.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.déposer le binaire, ouvrir le verrou glo: upload the binary, open the global lock, then open A SINGLE pilot screen. Check that it comes back online, that its version changed in the table above, and that it works. Then open the others. If something goes wrong, closing the global lock stops the rollout dead: screens that have not updated yet keep querying and receive "no update".
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.ne reçoit que les six premiers boutons,: only receives the first six buttons, navigation buttons excluded, renumbered from 0 to 5. It stays usable in degraded mode rather than receiving a structure it cannot understand.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.À coller dans un terminal pour vérifier: To paste in a terminal to check the link without the board.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Chaque bouton porte un libellé, une coul: Each button carries a label, a colour, an icon and a mode. In "Plain action" a press always plays the same command — that is what a gate or a scenario needs. In "Switch" the plugin reads the state and plays the opposite command: one press turns on, the next turns off. In "Navigation" the button opens another page: it commands nothing at all, and the board answers it by itself, without the network.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/php/glowscr.Ignorer la valeur si elle date de plus d: Ignore the value if it is older than this many MINUTES, and leave the banner empty. 60 by default, 0 to never expire. An empty banner is honest; yesterday's temperature shown as if it were current is not, and that is worse than useless on a panel glanced at in passing. The threshold depends on the sensor: a weather station refreshes every ten minutes, an energy meter every second. It is the COLLECTION date that is read, not the date of the last value change — a stable temperature is not a stale one.

plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Choisir la commande qui allume: Pick the command that turns on
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Choisir la commande qui éteint: Pick the command that turns off
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Secours seulement : le plugin choisit no: Fallback only: the plugin normally picks "Turn on" or "Turn off" from the state, because an out-of-sync "toggle" command inverts the state shown on the screen. It is only used when the state becomes unreadable.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Le plugin lit l'état, puis joue la comma: The plugin reads the state, then plays the opposite command: one press turns on, the next turns off.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Une commande d'action ou un scénario, jo: An action command or a scenario, played as is on every press. For a pulse relay, a gate, a scene.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Obligatoire : sans état, rien ne permet: Required: without a state, nothing decides whether to turn on or off. Saving is refused.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Facultatif. Laissé vide, le plugin repre: Optional. Left empty, the plugin reuses the state Jeedom already links to the action command.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Nom d'icône que le firmware saura dessin: Icon name the firmware knows how to draw: bulb, movie, fan... Free text in v1.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Ce bouton ne commande rien : la carte ch: This button commands nothing: the board changes page on its own, without going through the network. It therefore stays usable when Jeedom is unreachable.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Cet écran porte plus de boutons que le m: This screen carries more buttons than the maximum allowed. Saving will be refused.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Cette case sort de la grille choisie : l: This slot is outside the chosen grid: the plugin will move the button to the first free slot.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Choisissez d'abord le fichier .bin à dép: Choose the .bin file to upload first.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Firmware déposé. Il ne part nulle part t: Firmware uploaded. It goes nowhere until both locks are open.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.La page 0 est la page d'accueil : c'est: Page 0 is the home page: the one the board shows at boot, and it has no parent page. With no title, the screen name shows in the banner.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Le bouton ouvre une autre page de cet éc: The button opens another page of this screen. It commands nothing and has no state; a board whose firmware predates v2 will not see it at all.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Retirer le firmware déposé ? Le binaire: Remove the uploaded firmware? The binary will be erased from the server; screens already updated are untouched.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Verrou global fermé. Plus aucun écran ne: Global lock closed. No screen will receive an update any more.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.Verrou global ouvert. Seuls les écrans d: Global lock open. Only screens whose own lock is open will receive the update.
plugins/glowscreen32/desktop/js/glowscre.sans en-tête de schéma — une carte antér: no schema header — a board predating v2
